## App Factory Core change

### Scope
- [ ] Master Prompt
- [ ] CURRENT resolver
- [ ] Golden Index / Registry
- [ ] Golden content
- [ ] Bootstrap / governance
- [ ] Validation / CI

### Required checks
- [ ] Based on the current Factory baseline from CURRENT.yaml.
- [ ] CURRENT aliases and versioned files updated together when applicable.
- [ ] Golden Registry and Index agree on path/status/version.
- [ ] No Golden promotion without required evidence.
- [ ] Provider-sensitive guidance has real provider verification or NEEDS_REVIEW.
- [ ] No secret/key/credential committed.
- [ ] GitHub Actions pinned to immutable commit SHAs.
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated.
- [ ] Validate App Factory Core is GREEN.

### Evidence / notes
Describe source evidence, donor/project SHA, provider docs/version, or reason.
